items.title: Union Pacific Helps Keep Soccer Fans Moving This Summer
items.summary: Union Pacific Railroad worked closely with passenger rail partners during this summer’s international soccer tournament to help keep thousands of fans safely moving to and from matches across the network, including in California, Missouri, Texas and Washington.

items.title: US Speedskater Gains Real-World Engineering Experience Through Union Pacific Internship | Union Pacific
items.summary: A member of the US Speedskating National Team, Jonathan Tobon has spent years competing at the highest levels of the sport. This summer, he’s gaining hands-on engineering experience at Union Pacific while continuing to pursue his athletic goals.

items.title: Union Pacific Corporation Announces 3% Dividend Increase for Third Quarter 2026
items.summary: Union Pacific Corporation announced that its Board of Directors today voted to increase the quarterly dividend on the Company’s common shares by 3% to $1.42 per share. The dividend is payable September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record August 31, 2026.

items.title: UP beefs up intermodal service
items.summary: Union Pacific Railroad has added 11 intermodal train starts between Northern California and Portland, Oregon, and Chicago this year, potentially allowing the carrier to grab business from customers frustrated with BNSF’s ailing service.

items.title: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern Affirm Strength of Merger Application and Offer Unprecedented New Customer Assurances
items.summary: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern enhanced their merger application by offering customer protections that go beyond those provided in any prior rail merger. The new commitments are provided with the supplemental information requested by the STB when it accepted the companies’ merger application as complete on May 28, 2026.
